Reply/contact flow: anonymous email relay form (name, email, phone optional, message) with validation and a sent confirmation; the poster receives the message in the local outbox, never exposing a real address.
Save-search action: requires sign-in (anonymous gets a sign-in prompt), persists the query under the account, lists saved searches on the account page.
Favorite/bookmark toggle on a listing; requires sign-in; saved under the account and listed on the account favorites page.
Create-a-posting wizard entry: requires sign-in (anonymous gets the sign-in/permission prompt), step 1 category choice.
Wizard step: choose category and subcategory (housing > sublets & temporary).
Wizard step: choose region and neighborhood (Toronto > Annex).

Wizard step: title, price, postal code, housing attributes (housing type, bedrooms, baths, square feet, available date, laundry, parking, AC), description; inline validation for required fields and price format.
Wizard step: contact method (email/phone), anonymous reply settings; validation for contact fields.
Wizard step: photo upload, drag-to-reorder, remove; images stored locally under the site data directory.
Wizard step: preview the post exactly as it will appear in the listing detail, then continue to publish.
Publish action and confirmation: the posting becomes live at its canonical detail URL, the confirmation names the posting id and offers view/edit/delete and post-another.
Edit an existing posting owned by the current user; non-owner or anonymous gets a permission prompt.
Renew a posting (bump date) for the owner; permission-checked.
Repost a posting as a new posting (new id) for the owner; permission-checked.
Delete a posting after confirmation; the detail URL then renders the removed state; permission-checked.
Sign-in entry: email + password fields, password/identity-provider choices, return-without-submit is always possible; wrong credentials render an error.
Registration entry: email, password, confirm password, terms links, verification guidance; five-minute per-email rate limit; no account is created when fields are invalid.
Password recovery entry: reset-address (email) field, validation guidance, return-to-sign-in link; submitting renders a neutral sent state and never exposes whether the email exists.
Password reset from a single-use expiring token; expired or reused tokens render an expired state with a re-request link.
Account home: the user's postings (newest first) with status (active/renewed/removed), detail link, edit/renew/repost/delete actions, and a route back to the relevant collection; requires sign-in.
Saved favorites collection for the signed-in user; requires sign-in.
Saved searches collection for the signed-in user; requires sign-in.
Account settings: email display, notification preferences, sign-out; requires sign-in.
Reporting/flagging control on a listing: reason picker, optional note, sent confirmation; no account data is exposed.
Public help/support entry: FAQ topics covering posting, housing, account access, and failed actions without exposing private account data.
Help topic: posting guidance (create, edit, renew, delete, photos, preview, publish).
Help topic: account access, sign-in, registration, password recovery.
About page with contact entry links.
Public contact/feedback entry (help blocks, abuse reports, general contact) with no private account data required.
Terms of use page linked from registration.
Privacy policy page linked from registration.
Other curated regions (vancouver, montreal, newyork, losangeles, chicago, seattle, london, sydney): region shell with empty or light housing data.
